title: Compare Foundation Shade Ranges with the Market
text: shaderange package helps beauty product strategy managers find next foundation launch stand . compares brand’s foundation shades whole market across two major US beauty retailers, Sephora Ulta. comparison shows brand offers smaller share deep, medium light shades market, bands whole market leaves thin. Depending result, lists competitor products leading either brand’s weakest band, benchmark catch , market’s thinnest band, chance stand . package contains: foundation_shades: 6,774 foundation shades 107 brands, collected Sephora Ulta websites early 2021 shade_supply(): summarises shade supply lightness band brand_gaps(): compares brand’s shade mix market run_app(): launches interactive Shiny app exploring brand gaps Documentation website: https://etc5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-miriam0085/
